name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site document roots, static content, security controls, certificates, Fail2ban, firewall, SSH hardening, and a site token secret.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, runtime directories, logging, service enablement, and configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application from Git with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a virtual environment, database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a Uvicorn systemd service.
